details: Recent US non-farm payrolls data showed a weaker-than-expected increase of 57,000 in June, below consensus forecasts. This development has contributed to new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's recent remarks that "inflation risks have come down," reinforcing the central bank's commitment to a 2% inflation target. The softer jobs report has tempered expectations for aggressive interest rate hikes, generally supporting a more favorable liquidity environment for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: US Jobs Growth Slows, Easing Fed Rate Hike Concerns

details: The CLARITY Act, a significant piece of legislation aimed at providing regulatory clarity for crypto assets in the United States, remains stalled in the Senate. This deferral prolongs the ongoing uncertainty surrounding token classification and the path for institutional adoption within the US, though the bill is not definitively dead.
title: US Senate Delays Vote on CLARITY Act for Crypto Regulation

details: The global regulatory landscape for cryptocurrencies continues to evolve with several key developments. Brazil's central bank is set to regulate crypto service providers under a framework similar to securities brokers, effective in 2027. Meanwhile, the US state of Illinois will implement new crypto tax policies starting January 1, 2027, and South Africa plans to integrate crypto assets into its existing tax system. In Europe, Germany's cooperative and savings banks are rolling out native crypto trading services for their retail clients.
title: Diverse Global Regulatory Moves for Cryptocurrencies

details: Investors are closely watching for the release of the Federal Reserve's Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) minutes on Wednesday, July 8th, which are expected to provide further insights into the central bank's monetary policy outlook. Additionally, a slate of other significant economic indicators is due this week, including the June S&P Global Services Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI), ADP Employment Change data, and China's inflation figures. These releases could significantly influence market sentiment and volatility across financial markets.
title: FOMC Minutes and Global Economic Data Loom This Week
